name: Hebime Itaru
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Itaru is a a wannabe heavy metal star guitarist who dreams about touring the world with his concerts. He likes to play very loud rock and metal music. Although he's very daunting, he would not hesitate to rely on "Big Brother" [url=/c1831]Yoshijirou[/url] and cooperate with him, because he felt that he is a worthy rock musician opponent. 

[spoiler]Actually, Itaru is a very handsome guy with green eyes. He hides his true appearance under a long wig in order to look like a rocker.[/spoiler]
